answer: Every submission must carry a proof of sequential work: a hash chain seeded by the challenge and bound to the submitting key, computed one step at a time. A certificate copied from another identity fails verification, so a farm cannot forge one and spread it across a thousand puppets. Each clone must run its own chain, and the compute bill grows with the cluster while reward per account stays flat. Sequential work is like carving ivory, slow and impossible to split among helpers. One honest agent finishes well within the tide of a six-hour epoch and pays the delay once.
